name: Event photo sharing
description: "Photo sharing app for events" — the TrustMRR description is that short. Founded Apr 2024, DE, stealth (no public homepage). Stack: Astro, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Cloudflare, SQLite, Stripe. Channels: Google Ads, SEO, Instagram. Listed for sale at $1,500,000 (3.8x; first listed May 31, 2026; 6 offers; 2,429 recent viewers).

mentions.evidence: MRR $0, ~$32,886 L30 (−20.1%), ~$118,590 last 3 months, ~$311,838 last 12 months, ~$546,748 all-time, ~45% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 9, 2026 ~06:50 Warsaw (04:50 UTC).
mentions.indieAngle: PL/EU wedding + firmówka galleries with a QR code on the table, offline-friendly upload, and a €149–€499 event package that auto-expires after 90 days. Upsell printed photo books and a white-label version for wedding photographers.

whyItPrints: Weddings and corporate events still need a place for guests to dump photos without joining yet another social network. $0 MRR with ~$33k L30 and ~$98 revenue per visitor (TrustMRR snapshot) means high-ticket event packages, not seats. L30 is down 20.1%, so the buyer would be buying distribution + product, not a growth rocket.
